details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1290-1301 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `update_completion_status_comment` accepts `status` without validating it against the allowed token set.
  WHY: Current callers use literals, but the helper contract has no whitelist, so a future bad caller could corrupt the `<!-- status:... -->` marker.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1305-1343 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: If the GitHub comment POST/PATCH fails, the helper still writes the body hash and can leave later identical bodies treated as already handled.
  WHY: The API call is wrapped in `|| true`, and the hash-cache write happens unconditionally afterward.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1305-1343 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: On transient API failure the helper returns 0 without recording the hash, so the next poll retries the same comment body and may create duplicates.
  WHY: The API call is swallowed, so the helper cannot distinguish success from failure before deciding whether the cache should be updated.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1327-1343, 4816, 4862, 4950, 10035 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Comment-update failures are swallowed and reported as success.
  WHY: The helper wraps the gh API calls in `|| true`, ends with `return 0`, and the call sites also suppress failures with `|| true`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4835-4843 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The validation-recovery branch updates state back to `in_progress` but does not refresh the pinned completion-status comment.
  WHY: The recovery path returns before calling `update_completion_status_comment`, so the comment stays stale until the next poll cycle.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10005-10030 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `implementation-failed` issues are listed in both the pending-merge section and the failed section of the pinned comment.
  WHY: The pending filter includes `implementation-failed` while the failed filter also selects it, so the same issue appears twice with conflicting framing.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4813-4818 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The deterministic validation-failure call site passes `"failed"` to `update_completion_status_comment` without an explicit validation guard.
  WHY: The helper accepts only the documented enum, but this call site forwards the status token directly.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4860-4863 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The recovery-exhausted validation-failure call site passes `"failed"` to `update_completion_status_comment` without an explicit validation guard.
  WHY: The helper accepts only the documented enum, but this call site forwards the status token directly.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4947-4950 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The validation-complete call site passes `"validated"` to `update_completion_status_comment` without an explicit validation guard.
  WHY: The helper accepts only the documented enum, but this call site forwards the status token directly.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10037 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The main-loop status update passes a computed token to `update_completion_status_comment` without an explicit validation guard.
  WHY: `_completion_status_text` is derived from JSON, but it is still forwarded directly instead of being checked against the allowed status set.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1301-1343 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `update_completion_status_comment` uses a cache file without any locking around the hash check, API call, and hash write.
  WHY: Concurrent orchestrator instances could race on the same cache file and make the idempotency check unreliable.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10043-10048 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The Telegram alert state update reads and writes the state file without an atomic read-modify-write boundary.
  WHY: A race between the jq read and the subsequent write could lose `completion_status_failure_alert_sent` updates.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4737 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `dispatch_validation_if_needed` has scattered local declarations and multiple early returns that make the flow hard to reason about.
  WHY: The function introduces variables late and exits through several branches, which makes future edits error-prone.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1331-1340 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: A temporary payload file is created and deleted on every call to `update_completion_status_comment`.
  WHY: This adds unnecessary filesystem I/O on a hot poll-cycle path.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1306-1313 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `TRACKING_NUM` is interpolated directly into the cache filename without sanitization.
  WHY: Special characters in the tracking number could make the cache path invalid or unexpected.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1275 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The new comment-header documentation does not link the completion-status helper back to the state-file contract.
  WHY: Readers get the canonical state-record description but not the field contract needed to validate the helper’s behavior.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10001-10013 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The wave-status block repeatedly re-parses the same `WAVE_STATUS` JSON blob with separate jq invocations.
  WHY: Each field extraction spawns a new jq process and reprocesses the full JSON, which is redundant on the poller’s critical path.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1321-1324 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The existing-comment lookup scans every comment body with `contains($marker)`.
  WHY: That creates an avoidable O(N*M) string scan over the cycle-local comments cache.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4701-4724 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `dispatch_validation_if_needed` treats an unset `PROJECT_COMPLETE` as "not gated" and proceeds to dispatch validation.
  WHY: The preflight only blocks when the variable is set and false, so an absent value can still allow a premature dispatch.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1327-1330 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: If payload creation fails, `update_completion_status_comment` still continues toward the GitHub API call path.
  WHY: The function can end up with an empty or missing payload file and the failure is not surfaced to the caller.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1319-1338 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: A malformed or missing `COMMENTS` cache can lead to duplicate pinned comments instead of an idempotent update.
  WHY: The lookup falls back to empty `existing_id`, and a concurrent race can make two pollers both choose the POST path.
- agents.md:132-154 | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The documentation says completion-status updates happen in both terminal branches of `mark_validation_failed` but omits the non-terminal recovery path.
  WHY: That wording can make readers assume the comment is always refreshed even when validation falls back to recovery.
- agents.md:132-142 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The documentation claims the V2 reader falls back to the legacy V1 marker, but no reader for the new pinned completion-status comment is implemented.
  WHY: The added code only writes the new marker while `extract_orchestrator_state_payload` still only understands V1.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1275-10037 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new helper name, its internal `_csc_*` variables, and the new completion-status marker introduce a contract surface that is not reflected in the documented stable-prefix list.
  WHY: Downstream log-analysis and API-hygiene consumers rely on the documented stable prefixes, so the missing contract entry can cause them to miss these events.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4835-4843 | confidence=3

  WHY: A reader may assume the comment is always refreshed when `mark_validation_failed` runs, when the recovery path leaves it stale for one cycle.
